title: Want a Credit Card Recommendation? Start With This Short Note
caption:
Want useful card advice? Start with your actual week, not a top-ten list.

Fictional note: “I pay in full by the due date. Monthly spending: roughly $600 groceries, $250 dining, $150 gas, $800 other. One unnamed cash-back card, no annual fee, used for everything. Cash back preferred, no flights planned, no monthly perk tracking.”

For yours, name your current cards. Rough totals are enough—leave out private documents and account details.

Spending sets the comparison; your wallet sets the baseline; patience rules out coupon homework. Carry a balance? Prioritize interest, fees, and repayment over rewards.

General education—not an approval or savings guarantee.

Start with the free basics: https://practicalrewards.com/learning.html
